description: This file defines the LanguageNegotiationSession class for handling language negotiation via session parameters in Drupal. It implements interfaces for outbound path processing, language switching, and plugin creation, and manages language persistence and URL modifications based on session data.

classes.name: LanguageNegotiationSession
classes.description: A class for handling language negotiation based on session parameters in Drupal, implementing multiple interfaces for path processing, language switching, and plugin factory.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the request stack dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with the request stack from the container.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the language code from the session or request query based on configuration.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Stores the selected language code into the session for authenticated users.

methods.name: processOutbound
methods.description: Modifies outbound URLs to include session-based language parameters and manages cache tags/contexts.

methods.name: getLanguageSwitchLinks
methods.description: Generates language switch links with session parameter considerations.
